title: Reconcile stale OSCORE replay persistence prohibition in security spec
description: spec/06-security.md Section 15.3 currently says OSCORE recipient/response replay state MUST NOT persist and restart may re-accept captures. This contradicts project-LICHEN-worker6-4num's required and implemented fail-closed Settings persistence for sender reservations plus recipient/response replay state. Update the normative paragraph to require authenticated/versioned context-bound persistence with protected monotonic rollback/deletion authority, or explicit fresh-key establishment on restart. The spec file had a concurrent large external edit during 4num, so this was deliberately not edited in that leaf.
notes: Confirmed spec/06-security.md was stable for more than eight minutes before editing and both active sibling workers reported no ownership. Replaced only Section 15.3 OSCORE replay-persistence contradiction: reused contexts now require versioned/authenticated exact-context-bound persistence, commit-before-nonce/plaintext semantics, independent monotonic rollback/deletion authority, fail-closed corrupt/torn/stale/missing/unavailable handling, and fresh distinct key/nonce material when recovery is impossible. Wording is aligned with RFC 8613 Sections 7.2 and 7.5. Scoped repository search found no remaining stale process-lifetime/MUST-NOT-persist/restart-reaccept claim; git diff --check passed. Existing unrelated 737-line accumulated diff was preserved.
